MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

6. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

9. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. D — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Red, blue, and yellow

6. B — Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — The speed of the music

9. A — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Singing games; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
